summary: Draganfly Inc. filed a Form 6-K on May 19, 2026, attaching a press release announcing the launch of the Draganfly Blitz advanced optical payload product line and a partnership with Blitz Technologies. The announcement details a new product family for drone optics, but does not involve an acquisition, divestiture, tender offer, or any other special-situation event. The filing is a routine current report of a foreign private issuer disclosing a commercial product launch and distribution agreement. There are no deal terms, shareholder votes, or structural changes to the company. This is an ordinary business development, not a special situation.
